RehabProfile.title: RehabProfile
RehabProfile.description: User profile and Feifei companion recovery state.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this profile.

feifeiNickname.description: Nickname for the user's Feifei companion (1-30 chars).

todayDate.description: Current local date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

todayCount.description: Number of micro-tasks completed on todayDate (0-999).

antibodyBalance.description: Spendable anti-laziness antibodies earned from completing tasks (0-9999999).

ownedItemIds.description: IDs of pharmacy items redeemed by the user.

equippedItemIds.description: Subset of ownedItemIds currently equipped around the doctor/bed stage.

wardPlacements.description: Encoded item placements in the cozy ward ('itemId:x:y').

RehabTask.title: RehabTask
RehabTask.description: A zero-pressure micro-rehab task item owned by the user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this task.

effortLevel.description: Task effort tier: micro (1-min), gentle (5-min), or boss (big task to break down).

category.description: Task category filter: daily, game, homework, course, or user custom category.

completed.description: Whether the micro-task is currently checked off.

completedDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD period key when completed, or empty string when pending.

note.description: Optional gentle encouragement or breakdown note (0-200 chars).

sortOrder.description: Custom display order index for drag-to-reorder.

timeSlotsEnabled.description: Whether this task splits into morning/noon/evening checkboxes.

morningEnabled.description: Whether morning slot is active when split mode is enabled.

noonEnabled.description: Whether noon slot is active when split mode is enabled.

eveningEnabled.description: Whether evening slot is active when split mode is enabled.

resetHour.description: Custom daily reset hour (0-23) for game category tasks.

deadlineDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD deadline date for homework category tasks.

RehabCheckin.title: RehabCheckin
RehabCheckin.description: Daily low-pressure energy and mood check-in entry.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this check-in.

energyPercent.description: Exact energy percentage (0-100) selected on the battery slider.

wardSnapshot.description: Snapshot of placed ward item coordinates ('itemId:x:y') when the diary entry was saved.

doctorPoseSnapshot.description: Encoded snapshot of the doctor's sprite, coordinates, facing direction, and anchor in the ward when saved.

completedTaskTitles.description: Snapshot of completed task titles saved on this diary day so they survive future daily resets.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile and Feifei companion recovery counters.

/users/{userId}/checkins/{checkinId}.description: User's daily energy and mood check-in log.
